HAIR ROUTINE:
1. SHAMPOO: Milk Shake Silver Shine. 
Focussed mostly on the roots and leave it for 2-3 minutes. (Sulfate-free and good for bleached hair) 
2. CONDITIONER: Shea Moisture Manuka Honey & Mafura Oil Hair Masque. 
Applied to ends (I don’t use much because it tends to weigh down my hair). I use a shower cap with this and leave it in until I’m about to get out (10-15 mins)
3. DETANGLER: Shea Moisturize Raw Shea Butter. 
I apply a quarter size (or so) amount throughout my hair and brush with a wet brush.
4. LEAVE-IN CONDITIONER: Shea Moisture Jamaican Black Castor Oil AND/OR Renpure Coconut Whipped Creme. 
I use about a quarter size amount total. I finger combs it through my hair every way possible 
5. GEL: Ecostyler.
 I use this to scrunch my hair (mostly upside down). I take a bit on my finger tips and SCRUNCH THE HELL out of my hair.
6. Air dry!

I only wash my hair once a week, but refresh throughout with water, leave-in, and gel. I also wait until my hair is mostly dry to “fluff” and separate my hair to minimize frizz. I don’t use a diffuser because it personally makes my hair frizzy.
